  • Classes in hadur2.core.policy used by hadur2.core.policy
    Class
    Description
    DistancePolicy.Step
    How a wave moved the target: IN a step on a certain lead of ours, OUT a step on their lead, or HOLD with no clear lead either way, no rates yet, or the target already at the bound it would move toward.
    Endgame.State
    The endgame state for one tick.
    MoveFlavour
    MOVE-2: when the enemy hits us more than its profile says it does, beyond the margin of error, the movement changes flavour at the next surfable wave.
    MoveFlavour.Step
    The flavours in the order they are added; each keeps the ones before it.
    PowerPolicy.Lead
    What the lead-aware regime (POW-7 to POW-9) asks of the gun's power: OFF leaves 1.20's choice, CHAFF is the minimum power, DEFAULT is the gun's base power without its power-down.
    PowerPolicy.Reason
    Why a shot got the power it did: GUN when no rule applies and the gun's own power stands, POW_1/POW_2/POW_3 for the full-power rules, POW_4 when the expected-value comparison picked full power over the gun's own.
